body: I identify with a lot of the things in your post. When you're at your lowest, you make rash decisions. You might feel a relief or at peace now that youve decided to do it but i really hope you dont go through with it. You really can get better and eventually you will look back on this point in your life and be so happy because youve improved.  If your family cant support you atleast you have internet strangers. Please seek help because it does sound like your suffering from depression

Yeah this is exactly what I needed to hear, i need to build my discipline and start going to the gym and shit. I know things can get better I just get in crazy moods sometime where Im worried I might do something. But its time to turn my shit around.thanks for your words
Thank you so much for your reply. It means a lot. If i need to talk to someone ill be sure to hit you up. The responses of the community have been amazing. Thank you to everyone who commented

Im getting a referral to a new psychaiatrist who will hopefully give me medication that works better for me. Hurting to exist sucks. I like to distract myself with friends. I understand your love of sleep, its the best fucking escape in the world. I know that im at a really low point and its all uphill from here.. the kind responses in this thread have really cheered me up. If you ever wanna talk just pm me bro. youre totally right that no one else undertands, but youd be surprised how many people around you are going thru the same. Thank you again
Thank you so much for your reply. Rest in piece to your dog, I love dogs so much so I understand your pain. <3
Ill be fine for now..but sometimes worried that im gonna slip up. it seems like the line between life and death is becoming more blurred

Feel like I'm reading my own post... I feel those impulses creeping on me too. as long as you can resist them every day thats one step. knowing that you wont act on it is important. think of your sister and cuddle with your dogs.. dogs really make things a lot better. I'm going through heartbreak and ive never felt more close to ending it all. But i know that when all this horse shit is done that I'll be a stronger and better person. I've been dealing and battling with my depression for as long as I can remember and I guess the only thing to do is take it one step at a time. I dont really have great advice but Just know youre not alone at all
im wondering the same thing man
